CONSULATE GENERAL FOR FINLAND
SHANGHAI
No. 854.

〔印章：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. D. 443 / Shanghai, 9th August, 1935. Date ...〕

Sir,

Some years ago the factory for the manufacture of fire-arms of the Finnish State gave its representation for China to Dr. Kurt Barth, 150 Kiukiang Road, Room 117, Shanghai. Some samples were bought by the representative who should take appropriate connections with the Chinese authorities. It has been told that a certain Mr. Sandler Jr. staying in the service of the representative has arranged an official show of the fire-arms to the authorities concerned.

As nothing has been heard about the mentioned gentlemen and no orders have been received, I have tried to investigate the matter. In the mentioned office room not such a gentlemen are to be found and the Chinese authorities do not know anything about any offer or show of arms made in Finland. The whole matter seems to me very doubtful. It has been suggested that perhaps the fire-arms sent from Finland have been used as samples in manufacturing the same in another country.

I would be highly thankful to you, Sir, for any informations concerning the personality and activities of those gentlemen mentioned above.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Yours most obedient servant
V. Niskanen
Acting Consul General.

F. W. Gerrard, Esquire,
Commissioner of Police Force,
239 Hankow Road,
Shanghai.

〔印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处特别巡捕房 D. 443 / 上海，1935年8月9日。日期 ...〕

先生，

数年前，芬兰国营枪械制造厂委任 Dr. Kurt Barth 为其在华代表，地址为上海九江路150号117室。该代表购买了一些样品，并应与中国当局建立适当联系。据称，在该代表处任职的一位 Sandler Jr. 先生安排了向有关当局正式展示这些枪械。

由于未闻上述绅士之消息，亦未收到任何订单，我曾试图调查此事。在上述办公室房间内并未找到此类人士，且中国当局对任何在芬兰进行的武器报价或展示一无所知。整件事在我看来非常可疑。有人建议，或许从芬兰运来的枪械已被用作在另一国家制造同类产品的样品。

如蒙阁下提供有关上述提及人士之身份及活动的任何信息，本人将不胜感激。

谨此致意，
先生，
您最顺从的仆人
V. Niskanen
代理总领事。

F. W. Gerrard 先生，
警务处处长，
汉口路239号，
上海。

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, THURSDAY, FEBRUARY 9, 1933.

GERMAN GIVEN ONE
YEAR SENTENCE

Morphia Manufacturers
Receive Hard Terms
In Nantao Court

One year's imprisonment and a
fine of $3,000 was the sentence
meted out to a German, one Pah
Tay, who was charged in the Nan-
tao District Court with the manu-
facture of morphia and drugs.
The German and two Chinese
were arrested by Nantao police
when the officials raided a house in
the Pah Hwa district. The Chin-
ese were Doong Yoong-pao and
King Ah-keng.
The two Chinese were adjudged
to be the assistants of the Ger-
man in the illegal manufactory,
and so were given sentences of six
months' imprisonment and a $300
fine each.
The German protested that he
was innocent and was engaged be-
cause he was an engineer. He
knew nothing of what the plant
was making until it was too late,
he told the Court. His story was
evidently not believed by Judge
Kwei, who presided.

Baxter.

吗啡制造者
在南市法院

一名名为 Pah Tay 的德国人因在南区地方法院被控制造吗啡及毒品，被判处一年监禁及罚款3,000美元。
当官员突袭法华区的一所房屋时，该德国人及两名中国人被南市警察逮捕。这两名中国人是 Doong Yoong-pao 和 King Ah-keng。
这两名中国人被判定为该德国人在非法制造工厂中的助手，因此各被判处六个月监禁及罚款300美元。
该德国人抗议称他是无辜的，受雇是因为他是一名工程师。他告诉法庭，直到为时已晚他才知道该工厂在生产什么。主持审判的桂法官显然不相信他的说法。

Baxter.

February 8, 1933. Afternoon Translation.

LABOUR.

Chen Pao and other local newspapers:

THE WORKERS OF THE WING ON NO.2 MILL.

Some time ago, the workers of the Wing On
No. 2 Mill, Woosung, demanded a bonus but the demand
was rejected. The local Tangpu and other official
organs mediated but without any result.
At 2 p.m. yesterday, the Social Bureau
held a mediation meeting at which two representatives
of the 8th District Cotton Weaving Workers Labour
Union were present. As no delegates of the management
were in attendance, the meeting was postponed.

Chen Pao and other local newspapers:

THE WORKERS OF THE DA SUN CLOTH FACTORY.

The Da Sun Cloth Factory, Chung Sifing Road,
Chapei, suspended business in December last. The local
Tangpu and other official organs mediated but the
management has not observed the decision reached by
the mediators.
Realizing that the Factory is purposely
delaying a settlement, the 6th District Cotton Weavers
Labour Union at 11 a.m. yesterday detailed ten
representatives to submit an appeal to the local Tangpu
and other official organs.
It is understood that the Social Bureau
will hold a further mediation meeting.

MISCELLANEOUS.

Chen Pao and other local newspapers:

HEARING OF MORPHIA MANUFACTURING CASE ENDED.

L 4431
Some days ago, the Public Safety Bureau and
the Peace Maintenance Corps raided a large Morphia
Manufacturing plant in Fah Hwa District. Three persons
were arrested: one a German named "Pah Ter" and two
Chinese workers named Doong Yoong-pao and King Ah-keng.
Raw materials for the manufacture of morphia, etc.
were seized.
The case was heard yesterday by Judge Kwei at
the Nantao District Court when judgment was delivered.
"Pah Ter" was sentenced to one year's imprisonment
and fined $3,000. Doong Yoong-pao and King Ah-keng who
were charged with assisting "Pah Ter" were sentenced to
six months' imprisonment each and fined $200.

February 4, 1933. Morning Translation.

LABOUR.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers:

WHARF WORKERS OF THE CHINA MERCHANTS S. N. CO.

With reference to the dispute over the dismissal
of 101 wharf workers of the China Merchants Steam Navigation
Company, it is now learned that at 2 p.m. yesterday the
representatives of the workers again met Doo Yuet Sun杜月笙
and another committeeman of the company to discuss the matter.
It was decided that the company will issue another month's
wages as retirement gratuity to the workers provided they are
members of the Wharf Workers Union.
The representatives accepted this offer; their
Union will submit to-day a list containing the names of
those workers who are entitled to receive two months' wages
as retirement gratuity and double pay for the 12th moon
(1932-1933).

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers:

MEETING OF DRY GOODS SHOP WORKERS.

At a meeting held at 2 p.m. yesterday by the
Dry Goods Shop Employees Union, it was resolved that the
120 employees who were dismissed by the Zau Van Sun邵萬生
and other dry goods shops on the day of "God of Fortune"
should proceed to the local Tangpu and Government organs
on the morning of February 4 to make an appeal for assistance.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers:

CABIN BOYS OF THE S.S. "WOOSUNG."

With reference to the trouble over the dismissal
of cabin boys by the comprador of the S.S. "Woosung", a
ship belonging to the Taikoo Steam Navigation Company, the
local Tangpu yesterday received a letter from the Central
Kuomintang Headquarters directing it to mediate in the matter.

MISCELLANEOUS.

Shun Pao:

TRIAL OF MORPHIA MANUFACTURING CASE CONCLUDED.

a large number of policemen and raided a morphia manufacturing
plant in the Fa Hwa District, resulting in the arrest of a
German named Tsah Ter* and two Chinese named Tung Yung Pao
and Ching Ah Keng. Materials for the manufacture of morphia
and a large box of narcotic together with the machinery were

February 4, 1933. Morning Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS.

seized. The Factory was then sealed and the accused were all taken to the Nantao District Court. After the procurator had concluded his investigations, the case was tried yesterday, during which "Pah Ter", the German engineer, stated that he is an American, and a man named Keh Lai Sing was the owner of the Factory, who engaged him to be an engineer to manufacture perfume. He denied that he had any previous knowledge of a morphia factory before entering the service. He further stated that he was arrested on the third day he entered the Factory. On the first day he entered the Factory, he discovered a box of narcotic and was informed that the manufacture of morphia was also being conducted in the Factory. He asked the owner to remove the narcotics, failing which he would refuse to continue working there, but he was arrested before leaving the Factory.
When Tung Pao Chen, a Chinese boy, a native of Ningpo, was questioned, he stated that he was engaged as a coolie for the Factory by a Frenchman. He knew that perfumes only were being manufactured in the Factory. Only "Pah Ter" was his master, and he has not received any pay yet.
Next Ching Ah Keng stated that he was engaged to work in the Factory by a foreigner and it was his fourth day at work when he was arrested. His master was "Pah Ter" who could speak the Chinese language a little.
According to a Police patrol leader, a package of morphia material was found in "Pah Ter"'s trunk. The trial was brought to a close.

Shun Pao:

IMITATED WEIGHTS AND MEASURE PROHIBITED BY SOCIAL BUREAU.

The Bureau of Social Affairs has instructed the Chamber of Commerce to notify the various merchants that all imitation standard weights and measures are strictly prohibited.

Shun Pao

THE INAUGURATION OF THE NORTH EASTERN MUTUAL AID ASSOCIATION.

Mayor Wu Te Chen, Messrs. Chang Tsung Chuan, Ling Keng Hou and others have organized a North-Eastern Mutual Aid Association for the purpose of rendering assistance to the North-Eastern people. This Association was formally inaugurated at 4 p.m. yesterday in the Chinese Y.M.C.A. in the French Concession. Mayor Wu presided.
After a speech delivered by Dr. Tsai Yuan Peh, regulations governing the Association were passed and an Executive Committee of 27 men was elected.
The office of the Association will be temporarily situated in the premises of the China Aviation Union, 90 Jessfield Road.

当讯问宁波籍中国少年 Tung Pao Chen 时，他称自己是被一名法国人雇佣为工厂苦力的。他知道工厂只生产香水。只有“Pah Ter”是他的主人，而他尚未收到任何工资。

page_data.en:
Dr. Kurt Barth and M. Estublier

Enquiries indicate that the raid on a morphine factory,
which was established in January 6, 1933 under the cloak of the
Shanghai Perfume Manufacturing Factory at 1/14 Cong Shing Lee (    )
near Hoo Hu Store Bridge (    ) French Concession, Chinese con-
trolled territory, was made by the 3rd Police Division of the 5th
Division of the Public Safety Bureau at 11 a.m. January 11, 1933,
when a German named Dr. Kurt Barth (Vide report re Eliopoulos Case,
dated October 17 and Nov. 17, 1932), three Chinese workers and the
landlord of the premises were arrested and 32 tael's of morphine, 47
packages of eucodeine and ingredients were seized. In addition 7
motors together with various other laboratory apparatus and furni-
ture were also confiscated, but are still kept in the factory, the
doors of which have been sealed up. According to a statement made
by Dr. Kurt Barth at the 3rd Department (Police Court) of the
Public Safety Bureau, the factory was established by an American
citizen named "Kressin". However, one Lee Tai Kee (    ) a French-
speaking Chinese tailor, whose shop is at Nos. 345/7 Avenue Joffre,
states that the factory was owned by a French pharmacist named
L. Estublier, proprietor of the Pharmacie Loderne, 455 Avenue Joffre.
In October last M. Estublier informed the tailor that, owing to the
heavy Customs duty on imported goods, he wished to establish a soap
factory at Siccawei and asked him to act as his guarantor in the
leasing of the house. The tailor added that L. Estublier, together
with landlord of the premises, called at his shop on two or three
occasions. As L. Estublier used to be his neighbour as well as
customer, the tailor agreed to act as guarantor and affixed the
chop of his shop to the agreement. Enquiries indicate further that
a Russian physician named Dr. J.P. Ryabine, who resides at 183
Rue Remi, had also a certain interest in the undertaking. It is not
believed that Dr. Kurt Barth invested any money into the enterprise,
because he has recently been in financial difficulties and his
credit ex exhausted. Lieu Hung Sun (    ) the landlord of the pre-
mises in question has been released on security. He is a native of
Shanghai, age 50, and is a butcher by trade. Dr. Kurt Barth, the mana-
-ger of the factory and the three Chinese workers have been referred
to the Shanghai District Court for trial.

库尔特·巴特博士（Dr. Kurt Barth）与 M. Estublier

经查，1933年1月11日上午11时，公安局第五分局第三警察分区对一家吗啡工厂进行了突击搜查。该工厂伪装成“上海香水制造厂”，于1933年1月6日在法租界华界交界处的胡虎Store桥（原文不清）附近的丛兴里1/14号（原文不清）设立。行动中逮捕了一名德国人库尔特·巴特博士（参见1932年10月17日及11月17日关于埃利奥普洛斯案的报告），三名中国工人以及该处所房东，并查获吗啡32两、二氢可待因47包及原料若干。此外，还没收了7辆汽车以及各种其他实验室设备和家具，但这些物品仍存放在已被封门的工厂内。据库尔特·巴特博士在公安局第三科（警察法庭）所作的供述，该工厂由一名名为“克雷辛”（Kressin）的美国公民设立。然而，一位通晓法语的中国裁缝李泰记（音译），其店铺位于霞飞路345/7号，称该工厂归法国药剂师 L. Estublier 所有，后者是霞飞路455号现代药房（Pharmacie Loderne）的店主。去年10月，Estublier 先生告知该裁缝，由于进口货物关税沉重，他希望在徐家汇建立一家肥皂厂，并请他在租赁房屋时担任担保人。该裁缝补充说，L. Estublier 曾与该处所房东一同到过他的店铺两三次。由于 L. Estublier 既是他的邻居又是顾客，该裁缝同意担任担保人，并在协议上加盖了其店铺印章。进一步调查显示，居住在雷米路183号的一位名叫 J.P. Ryabine 博士的俄罗斯医生也对该企业有一定的利益关系。人们认为库尔特·巴特博士并未向该企业投入任何资金，因为他最近陷入财务困境，信用已耗尽。涉案处所的房东刘洪声（音译）已获保释。他是上海人，现年50岁，职业为屠夫。工厂经理库尔特·巴特博士及三名中国工人已被移送上海地方法院受审。

Copy of a Report on a Raid on a Morphia Factory at
Fah Hwa Village.
------------------------------------

Enquiries made show that the raid on a morphia factory, which
had been established under the cloak of the Shanghai Perfume Manu-
facturing Factory in the Oong Ching Lee (鸿慶里) near Hwo Ka
Stone Bridge (夏家石橋), Fah Hwa Village, was made at 11 a.m. on
January 12 by the 2nd Police Station of the 6th Division at Siccawei
when a German named Barter, aged 51 years, three Chinese employees and
the landlord of the house were arrested and 32 ozs of morphia and 27
packets of narcotics were seized. The apparatus, furniture, etc.,
are still kept in the factory, the doors of which have been sealed
up.

According to a statement made by Barter at the 3rd Department
(Police Court) of the Public Safety Bureau, the factory was estab-
lished by an American citizen named "Ko Ser". However Zee Tai
Kee (徐泰記), a French-speaking Chinese tailor, whose shop is at
Nos. 345/7 Avenue Joffre, says that the factory is owned by a French
pharmacist named L. Estublier, proprietor of the Pharmacie Moderne,
455 Avenue Joffre. In October last M. Estublier informed the tailor
that, owing to the heavy Customs duty on imported goods, he wished
to establish a soap factory at Siccawei and asked him to act as his
guarantor in the leasing of a house. The tailor added that M.
Estublier, together with the landlord of the house, called at his
shop on two or three occasions. As M. Estublier used to be his
neighbour as well as a customer, the tailor agreed to act as
guarantor and affixed the chop of his shop to the agreement. The
rent of the house is $166 per month.

Lieu Hung Sun (劉洪声) the landlord of the house in question,
has been released on security. He is native of Shanghai, aged 50,
and is a butcher by trade.

Barter, the Manager of the Factory, and the three Chinese
prisoners have been referred to the Shanghai District Court for
trial.

据巴特在公安局第三科（警察法庭）所作的供述，该工厂由一名名为“Ko Ser”的美国公民设立。然而，徐泰記（Zee Tai Kee），一位通晓法语的中国裁缝，其店铺位于霞飞路345/7号，称该工厂归法国药剂师 L. Estublier 所有，后者是霞飞路455号现代药房（Pharmacie Moderne）的店主。去年10月，Estublier 先生告知该裁缝，由于进口货物关税沉重，他希望在徐家汇建立一家肥皂厂，并请他在租赁房屋时担任担保人。该裁缝补充说，Estublier 先生曾与该房屋房东一同到过他的店铺两三次。由于 Estublier 先生既是他的邻居又是顾客，该裁缝同意担任担保人，并在协议上加盖了其店铺印章。该房屋租金为每月166元。

涉案房屋房东刘洪声已获保释。他是上海人，现年50岁，职业为屠夫。

工厂经理巴特及三名中国囚犯已被移送上海地方法院受审。
